Sent from my iPhone. Excuse any typos....

Am 24.10.2012 um 16:27 schrieb harry7777777 notifications@github.com:

> After switching to the latest Netty (3.5.8) our system now is now utterly broken thanks to this NPE:

> at org.jboss.netty.util.HashedWheelTimer$Worker.waitForNextTick(HashedWheelTimer.java:456)

JDK
java version "1.7.0_07"
Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 1.7.0_07-b10)
Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 23.3-b01, mixed mode)

Linux ip-10-60-117-209 3.2.30-49.59.amzn1.x86_64 #1 SMP Wed Oct 3 19:54:33 UTC 2012 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

Special container: No

@harry7777777 I think I fixed it...

Could you test out the following snapshot:
http://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots/io/netty/netty/3.5.9.Final-SNAPSHOT/netty-3.5.9.Final-20121024.165131-1.jar

?
I'm not sure that will fix it since System.getProperty("os.name") returns "Linux" on my system.
that's strange as this is the only way it could break.. please check with the fix...
Where can I track down the source for DetectionUtil.java:41, specifically the 3.5.8 final release?

btw.. I just double-checked and I think the problem is more in SystemPropertyUtil which loads the System.properties to early..

The source can be found here:
https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/netty-3.5.8.Final/src/main/java/org/jboss/netty/util/internal/DetectionUtil.java#L41
b9429c930fc5efcf9a2bf827f940f75771190b4d changes `SystemPropertyUtil` so that it gets the system property on-demand.  Feel free to reopen the issue if you still experience this problem.
Thanks guys! Any idea when this will be released? 3.5.8 is currently unusable for us.
@theorangesock will work on a release tomorrow
